title: Lie weights for CM curves and unipotent Selmer dimensions
summary: We prove an equidistribution result for Galois characters in the graded Lie components $L_n$ associated to the $\mathbf{Q}_p$-fundamental group of a projective hyperbolic curve $X$ over a number field $k$ with geometrically CM Jacobian. That is, we consider the $p$-adic completion of a fixed character lattice, where we define measures $μ_n$ counting normalized character multiplicities in $L_n$, and show that $(μ_n)_n$ weakly converges to the Haar measure.
